name_input: GNA DURAPARTS PRIVATE LIMITED; GNA GEARS LIMITED; GNA DURAPARTS LIMITED; GNA DURAPARTS (P) LTD
export_evidence: ImportKey India customs page for GNA GEARS LIMITED (https://importkey.com/countries/india/gna-gears-limited): "Total Shipments 1746 Records detected ... Trading Partners 27 ... Latest Cargo 2026-02-28". Exact row quoted: "2026-02-28 | GNA GEARS LIMITED | MAGNA POWERTRAIN GMBH CO KG. | AUTO PARTS:- M0030281-05 SPROCKET INPUTFIAT GIO ATC (1188 PCS)- GRFL SAHNEWAL LUDHIANA | ICD INSGF6, India | Hamburg, Austria | 87089900 | 1123103". Further rows seen: 2026-02-27 MERITOR HVS CAMERI S.P.A., Genoa Italy, HS 87089900, BOL 1075773; 2026-02-26 MERITOR DO BRASIL, Santos Brazil, HS 87089900, BOL 1054829; 2026-02-25 JCB TRANSMISSIONS, London Heathrow UK, HS 87089900, BOL 1006950; 2026-02-21 MERITOR B.V, Gothenburg Sweden, HS 87089900, BOL 9881847. Source counter: page states 1746 total shipments; 5 individual rows actually rendered on the free view.
domestic_evidence: No GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender award or annual-report domestic/export split could be retrieved: web_search tool returned "no results (searx: <urlopen error [Errno 111] Connection refused>)" on all three attempts, so no registry/tender page was reachable. Only company-site statement found (https://www.gnagears.com/): "It is the prominent manufacturer and exporter of auto ancillary products. The major chunk of exports serves the United States, France, Italy, Brazil, Sweden, UK, Turkey, and many more nations." This is a self-declaration, not a supply record; no domestic invoice, contract or tender line was seen.
note: Legal entity GNA GEARS LIMITED is the one with verifiable shipments; the three 'GNA DURAPARTS' name variants produced no records at all. ImportKey pages for https://importkey.com/countries/india/gna-duraparts-private-limited, .../gna-duraparts-limited and .../gna-duraparts-pvt-ltd all rendered empty record tables ("Loading..." / no rows, no shipment count), i.e. 0 rows seen out of an unstated total — so for the Duraparts entity specifically there are no traces of supplies found, neither export nor domestic. HS discrepancy: declared HS 848390 (parts of gearing/transmission) vs. actual customs HS on every observed row 87089900 (other parts/accessories of motor vehicles). Per project rule 3 this is not a rejection ground: company retained, code corrected to the factual 87089900, verdict accepted_hs_corrected. Industry claim 'Металлургия и горнодобыча' (metallurgy/mining) does not match reality — the company is an automotive/transmission gear manufacturer (crown wheels, ring gears, bull gears, shafts) supplying Magna, Meritor, JCB, Turk Traktor. Revenue and export volume figures: null — no public figure obtained, not invented. Role: manufacturer (own plants at Phagwara/Sahnewal, Ludhiana, Punjab), not a trader. No sanctions/court data checked in this pass.
